name: tg-daily-tracker
description: IELTS trainer — Telegram Mini App: daily words with spaced repetition, task of the day, Reading tests, lesson & homework reminders. Serverless on Cloudflare Workers + D1 (free tier).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w apps/worker
